title: Comment on “The impact of orthodontic treatment on face and smile attractiveness: A cross-sectional study of longitudinal data”
html: We read with great interest the study by Coppola et al,1 which evaluated the effect of orthodontic treatment on facial and smile attractiveness using a layperson-based assessment framework. The attempt to quantify perceptual changes using standardized visual analog scale ratings offers clinically relevant insight into patient-centered outcomes.
